summary: A DocsNav sidebar with two groups and a TableOfContents of four headings rendered side by side.
use: Documentation pages that need a section navigation tree next to an inline outline of the current page.
spec: `groups` typed `DocsNavGroup[]` has 2 groups: Get started with 2 items and Messages with 4 items
`headings` typed `DocsHeading[]` has 4 entries with `id`, `text` and `depth` of 2 or 3
